title: Manuscript Scholarly & Public Knowledge Reasoning Graph v1.0
description: Multi-layer scholarly + philological reasoning graph. LOD tiers, non-overlapping node/edge attributes, relation-level source_type/target_type gates, explicit FAQ/Causal bindings. schema_version=1.0.

dag_hash.description: Stable SHA-256 lock over sorted nodes/edges (audit lineage).

ManuscriptAttributes.description: Bibliographic, scholarly, lay-accessibility, and graph-dynamics attributes for Manuscript nodes.

AuthorAttributes.description: Identity, expertise, impact, and social/reasoning attributes for Author nodes.

subgraph.description: Optional document-structure / discourse subgraph id (e.g. 'docstruct:WITNESS:TRS') for LOD isolation.

attributes.description: Polymorphic bag; validated by allOf if/then on type (no catch-all).

confidence_score.description: Edge-only: strength of this relational assertion (not a node intrinsic).

do_action.description: Edge-only interventional label; CounterfactualIntervention nodes hold SEM fields.

relevance_score.description: Edge-only: how strongly source answers / relates to target question.

consensus_status.description: Edge-only: consensus state of this relational answer/link.

LodTier.description: Level-of-detail tier so GDB engines can exclude MICRO_PHILOLOGICAL containment from macro epistemic traversals.
